# Share the book {#sec-sharing}

## HTML for the browser

From the repository root:

```bash
quarto render 11-book --to html
```

Share the complete `11-book/_book/` directory through a static website host.
The HTML edition includes chapter navigation and search.

## EPUB for an e-reader

```bash
quarto render 11-book --to epub
```

EPUB is a single file and does not require LaTeX.

## PDF for printing

Install a LaTeX distribution such as TinyTeX once, then render:

```bash
quarto install tinytex
quarto render 11-book --to pdf
```

The outline in @tbl-outline and the chapter link to @sec-writing are resolved
for each output format. Preview your chosen format before sharing it.
